sub_sector.value: logistics real estate investment trust (industrial warehouses); data center development; energy and mobility services

financial_business_type.detail: Real estate investment trust owning and developing logistics facilities, also managing co-investment ventures for private capital partners.

revenue_driver.detail: Rental income from leased warehouses, plus fees from managed ventures and Essentials services such as energy and mobility.

customer_type.detail: Retailers, third-party logistics firms, e-commerce and data center tenants; institutional co-investors in ventures.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Owns and develops properties funded by debt and equity, with investment-grade credit ratings.
